## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all user-visible outcomes defined for the primary journey?
- [ ] CHK002 Are failure, empty, offline, retry, cancellation, and boundary states covered where relevant?
- [ ] CHK003 Are assumptions, dependencies, and out-of-scope behavior explicit?

## Acceptance and Testability

- [ ] CHK004 Does every high-priority user story have an independent, observable acceptance path?
- [ ] CHK005 Are success criteria measurable without depending on implementation details?
- [ ] CHK006 Are ambiguous terms replaced by concrete conditions or thresholds?

## Boundary and Compatibility Coverage

- [ ] CHK007 Are affected user surfaces and consumers identified?
- [ ] CHK008 Is compatibility behavior defined for existing mobile and web consumers?
- [ ] CHK009 Is the web application explicitly in or out of scope?

## Security and Data Coverage

- [ ] CHK010 Are authentication, authorization, ownership, privacy, and sensitive-data expectations defined where applicable?
- [ ] CHK011 Are data creation, update, retention, deletion, and migration consequences covered where applicable?
- [ ] CHK012 Are safe user-visible error outcomes specified without exposing internal details?

## Constitution Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 Do the requirements avoid forcing a violation of module or dependency boundaries?
- [ ] CHK014 Are contract, migration, test, and verification obligations represented where triggered?
- [ ] CHK015 Is every proposed governance exception explicit, temporary, and reviewable?

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Add findings or clarification notes inline.
- Link findings to exact requirement, scenario, plan, task, or contract identifiers.
- Keep item identifiers sequential and stable during review.
